HOW TO USE

Make every picture in a folder bigger and sharper in one Run, for printing, for a client, or before you crop. An upscale model adds detail, so it looks much better than stretching the picture.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Old Pictures inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Pick the final size

  • scale_by on Upscale Image By: 0.5 = 2 times the original (the default), 0.75 = 3 times, 1 = 4 times.
  • Very big pictures take longer and use more memory: a 2048 picture at 4 times is 8192 pixels wide. Start with 2 times.

 Want a fixed size instead, for example 2048 on the long side? Put Longest Side Pixaroma in place of Upscale Image By.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Upscale Model (4x NMKD Siax) - Loads the upscale model, 4x NMKD Siax. It always makes a picture 4 times bigger, and it adds real detail instead of only blurring the pixels larger.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at any folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and every picture is upscaled. Its resize is Off: the upscale model needs the original pixels.
  • Upscale Image By (2. final size: 0.5 = 2x the original) - Sets the final size. scale_by 0.5 halves the 4 times bigger picture, so the result is 2 times the original, and sharper than a plain 2x resize. Type 1 to keep 4 times, 0.75 for 3 times.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Upscale Image (using Model) (the model adds detail at 4x) - Runs the model on each picture. The model always works at 4 times the size (a 1024 picture becomes 4096) and adds real detail; the next node sets the FINAL size.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (with the original names) - Saves every picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Upscaled, with its original name.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
6 pictures, 1024 to 2048 (the demo)about 24 s
Each 1024 picture you addabout 4 s more

Measured on an RTX 4090, model loading included. Bigger pictures take longer: the time grows with the number of pixels. The model is small, so slower cards work too, only slower.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • The upscale took about 2.5 times as long.
